author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Given that Sony holds the marketing rights for Grand Theft Auto 6, Microsoft has had to get creative to promote the open-world crime game for Xbox--and the company's latest effort in that department goes big.

Say Hello to the X-Bite, a playable Xbox Series X console that was designed to look like it was swallowed whole by one of Florida's millions of alligators. Microsoft only made one of these ornate consoles, and you have to win a contest to get it.

Microsoft's b
title: This Custom Xbox-Inside-An-Alligator Console Is Actually One Big Ad For GTA 6

author: Mark Delaney
description:
Before I jumped into Gravhounds, the new third-person co-op shooter from Octopus Panic, the most pressing questions on my mind were centered on gameplay. In trailers, it seemed to have touches of both Helldivers 2 and Deep Rock Galactic, so I wondered which it resembled more. I saw elements of physics-based gameplay, so I was curious how chaotic that might get. With its alien worlds, I was eager to know what exploration was like. 

But once I finally got into the game, I was struck by a more immediate conundrum: Which dog do I pick?

Out now in early access on PC and consoles, Gravhounds is a third-person shooter with tower-defense and extraction elements. It is a little like Helldivers 2, a bit more like Deep Rock Galactic, and the physics of its world are fun, but damn, I took a lon
title: Don’t Make Me Pick A Favorite Dog In This Co-Op Game

author: Kevin Knezevic
description:
It's the final month of Pokemon Go's Twilight Trails season, and the game is closing things out in a big way. New and returning Dynamax Pokemon will appear in various events over the next few weeks, including Gigantamax Duraludon, which is set to debut during this month's global Go Wild Area.

A new selection of legendary and Mega Pokemon are returning to Raids as well in November. You can also expect to encounter new Spotlight Pokemon this month, and Eternamax Eternatus will make another rare appearance during the Dynamax Trails event.

You can read more about this month's biggest Pokemon Go events below.
title: Pokemon Go November 2026 Events: Raids, Spotlight Hours, Community Day, And More

author: Cameron Koch
description:
World of Warcraft: Forever just received a massive batch of class-balance updates ahead of launch that have boosted power across the board, but one group of players isn't happy with the changes: Shamans.

Developer Blizzard recently released Forever's launch patch notes based on feedback and data accumulated during the beta, resulting in a power spike for all classes and major reworks for classes like Paladin and Rogue. Shamans, too, received some significant changes, most notably the removal of a key Elemental specialization ability, Lava Burst, along with any interactions other abilities had with it.<
title: WoW: Forever Shamans Are Protesting Class Changes After Being “Completely Ignored”

author: Tomas Franzese
description:
I think Star Wars Battlefront 3 might be cursed. For the past 20 years, several different game studios have attempted to create a third entry in Star Wars’ premier shooter sub-series, yet have failed over and over again. We learned last week that EA is reportedly developing Battlefront 3, but also that the project came at the cost of shutting down BioWare.

Battlefront 3 has always seemed like a no-brainer to make; 2005’s Star Wars: Battlefront 2 is widely beloved, and more personally, my favorite game of all time. Yet, the video game industry has never been able to actually launch a third installment in the popular series despite multiple attempts.
title: The Curse Of Star Wars Battlefront 3

author: Cameron Koch
description:
World of Warcraft: Forever is gearing up for launch with some major class balance changes, but don't expect any more for at least a month.

As detailed in Forever's launch patch notes, Blizzard is making some dramatic class changes, including major reworks to Rogue and Paladin talents, in time for release that will result in a big spike in player power. Blizzard said it has used all the data from the game's month-long beta to "get everything tuned to a reasonable place."

However, don't expect additional changes in the near future. Blizzard said it won't be making significant balance changes until sometime next month.
title: WoW: Forever Won’t Get More Class Balance Changes Any Time Soon

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Rockstar Games has confirmed more details about Grand Theft Auto 6's impending release on November 19, including more information about physical goodies. While the game itself won't be available on a disc, Rockstar is offering a printable physical GTA 6 cover art poster and a map of the game's setting, Leonida.

The poster and Leonida map will be available for free as digital downloads on GTA 6's official website on November 19. A double-sized physical version of the poster will be available "shortly after launch" from the Rockstar Store for 99 cents. Alternatively, it's free with
title: GTA 6 Is Getting A Physical Map–Here’s How To Get One For Free Or Very Cheap

author: Cameron Koch
description:
World of Warcraft: Forever is changing in some major ways for launch, with Blizzard revealing classes across the board will deal more damage as it pursues design solutions that better fit in with Forever's combat.

In a lengthy developer note attached to Forever's launch patch notes, Blizzard outlined its philosophy for its latest version of WoW. It said during the game's nearly month-long beta that it was trying to keep player power in check. That meant every time it gave a class new tools and abilities, it had to tone down others to compensate. Blizzard now thinks that was the wrong approach.

"Those reductions left some iconic abilities feeling lackluster, and closed the door to other potentia
title: WoW: Forever Is Giving Players A Big Damage Boost For Launch

author: Mark Delaney
description:
Fortnite is a free-to-play game, but you probably already know that doesn't mean everything in Fortnite is free--not usually, anyway. But this month, pretty much everything in Fortnite's Item Shop will be free for a limited number of players and for a limited time.

As part of its new Treasure Hunters mini-season that began on November 1, players can find a rare in-game item that makes everything in the Item Shop free for 14 days, just in time for Epic to combat losing players to GTA 6.

The Fortnite Item Shop Token grants those who find it something called Pirate Shop Access. Players can find the token in chests during any round of battle royale. Things like team size, Build or Zero Build modes,
title: Fortnite’s Plan To Survive GTA 6 Is Finally Revealed: Make Everything Free

author: S.E. Doster
description:
Battlefield 6 is just a week away from its second phase of content for Season 5, and Battlefield Studios reveals the game's highly requested server browser feature will arrive after the big seasonal update rolls out. The studio highlights how the feature will work, and here's everything you need to know before Battlefield 6's server browsers go live.

Players have wanted a proper server browser since launch, and the feature was originally announced for December, but Battlefield Studios says it's arriving earlier to focus on stability before the holidays.

The server browser feature will rollout across two separate phases. Shortly after the Season 5 content drops on November 10, a limited group of players will receive access to the server browser as a stress test for the servers. Once the studio's data shows the feature is stable, the server browser will fully roll out for all players
title: See How Battlefield 6’s Highly Requested New Feature Works

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
To celebrate the 25th anniversary of Xbox this year, Microsoft has launched a "25 Years of Xbox" digital game bundle. It includes 25 games for $570.

That works out to about $23/game, but it's more nuanced than that, as some of the games are bundles themselves. For example, one of the games in the bundle, Halo: The Master Chief Collection, includes Halo 1, Halo 2, Halo 3, Halo 3: ODST, Halo: Reach, and Halo 4. There are Gears of War and Age of Empire bundles, too.

Some of the games in the bundle are for both Xbox and PC, and some are just for Xbox or just for PC. Additionally, many of the games in the pricy bundle are currently on Xbox Game Pass.

Given all of that, you may want to check your library and do some quick math before spending hundreds of dollars on this anniversary bundle.

2026 is the 25th annivers
title: 25 Years Of Xbox Bundle Includes All These Games For $570

author: Ben Janca
description:
“The scroll offered only a shimmer, a veil thinly lifted to my eyes. A future lost. A victory undone. Sands of time scattered by fate.”
Yazar, Moth Priest to High Queen Iradne of Hammerfell (4E 206)

Your next journey to Tamriel will be in The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel.
title: The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel – Official Name Reveal Trailer

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Indie game storefront Itch.io has announced it removed "a couple terabytes of AI slop" and has begun taking steps to combat the deluge of AI-created games appearing on the platform. "Just because you can upload 10 terabytes of poorly optimized AI-generated models doesn't mean you should upload 10 terabytes of poorly optimized AI-generated models," Itch wrote in a social media post.

The platform had already noted that the number of game pages being created per day had doubled from 3,000 to 6,000 over the last two months, with reports of users flooding the game uploads page with dozens of AI-created game spams
title: One Popular PC Game Storefront Has Had Enough Of AI Slop, And It’s Taking Action

author: Chris Pereira
description:
Confirming a recent report, Bethesda has confirmed the subtitle of the next Elder Scrolls game as The Elder Scrolls VI: Sentinel. This was shared as part of a 40-year-anniversary video recapping many of Bethesda's highlights over the year.

Unfortunately, that's all that was shared about the game, though we did get a (very familiar-looking) title card showing the game's name in the classic Elder Scrolls font. Bethesda subsequently shared a video with a scroll emerging from the sand, which you can see below.
title: The Elder Scrolls 6 Is Officially Titled Sentinel

author: Callum Self
description:
Many of the roguelites that I play are action-oriented. So, when Blue Prince kept the familiar "‘"one more run" vibes while removing the action that I so crave, I was intrigued. Thankfully, my intrigue paid off, giving me the chance to play one of 2025’s best games. If you’re keen to give Blue Prince a try, you can now get it at a huge discount thanks to a new Fanatical sale.

You start by entering the halls of Mt. Holly, and the name alone sets the tone for something mysterious. This manor isn’t just a simple building—it’s an ever-shifting layout hidden away by the walls surrounding it. Your goal is to reach the rumored Room 46 in the hopes of earning Simon his inheritance. Apparently, his great-uncle, the duke, simply couldn’t
title: This Puzzling “Very Positive” Roguelite Is Now Less Than Half Price, So It’s Time To Enter The Mysterious Manor

author: S.E. Doster
description:
The latest update arrived to Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 on November 2, and the patch notes detail several game fixes across multiplayer and DMZ. This brings much-needed spawn adjustments for the Shipment multiplayer map, but the biggest changes arrive in DMZ, countering the mode's powerful UAV towers.

Infinity Ward uses this update to address the community complaints around the abundance of UAV tower spam, which led to much of Hajin's map to be under constant radar pings. The new update randomizes UAV Tower spawns and reduces them by 40%. It also prevents multiple UAV towers from spawning in the same area. The only exception to these UAV changes is in Deadtown, as the area's tower is needed for DMZ Order progression
title: CoD: Modern Warfare 4 Patch Notes Address DMZ’s Biggest Issue

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Self-made millionaire Mark Tilbury has shared some advice for how buying GTA 6 can actually save you $5,000. Just don't take this too seriously.

Here's how he arrived at that number: If the game costs $100 (for the Ultimate Edition) and it takes 80 hours to complete, that works out to $1.25/hour of "fun." After adding on side missions and simply exploring GTA 6's map, investing in the game seems like an even better deal at just 50 cents of fun per hour.

If you play for four hours every evening, that's 50 nights of entertainment. Tilbury said people should compare this to a night out where they could easily spend $100 in a night.
title: Buying GTA 6 Could Save You $5,000, Or At Least This Guy Thinks So

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Xbox funded and published 2025's South of Midnight, a highly acclaimed action-adventure game set in the American Deep South. The game's creative director, David Sears, said he believes South of Midnight is a "generational" game that he hopes people discover and play for a long time and one that he thought would help elevate the "prestige" of Xbox.

At the same time, Sears said he wasn't sure Microsoft's spending spree under the previous leaders Phil Spencer and Sarah Bond--which is how Sears' studio Compulsion got the funding to make South of Midnight--was going to work out long term.

"I literally told people, I was like, 'Yeah, wow, this could be terrible.' Because somebody is going to say, someday, 'The money tap ... we're closing those floodgates.' And that's going to have really traumatic results downstream," he
title: South Of Midnight Director Says He Would Not Have Funded The Game

author: Phil Owen
description:
It's been a rough year for Fortnite, but Epic took a big swing with its new One Piece-themed Treasure Hunters season and, thankfully, it's paying off. Player counts are way up, with Fortnite's main Battle Royale mode averaging four times as many players on Sunday for the season launch than it had been the past few months. The numbers then got even larger on Monday, somehow. Fortnite BR now looks on track to have its best month since the original Fortnite OG mini-season in 2023. With GTA VI on the horizon, that's very good news for Epic.

There is one particularly obvious reason why the numbers are spiking so hard: The Trea
title: Epic Just Saved Fortnite–For Now, Anyway

author: Aaron Down
description:
Of all of World of Warcraft: Forever’s new dungeons, Excavation Site: Wetlands could very well be the shortest. It’s also one of the sweetest for lore-heads, owing to its links to the Dragonmaw Clan, Titans, and more. This self-contained safari won’t take particularly long to clear, but whether you’re Alliance or Horde it’s well worth venturing through.

Our Excavation Site: Wetlands guide will give you all the info you’ll ever need to navigate its danger-filled paths -- believe us, you’ll want to go in fully prepared. Below you’ll find not only directions for getting to the dungeon, but all of the quests you can clear (including their breadcrumbs), bosses you can beat, and loot you can fill your boots (or bags) with. While you can pick up all of the quests by the time you ding level 24, we’d recommend waiting until at least level 26 before heading in, based on the difficulty of its majo
title: WoW: Forever Excavation Site: Wetlands Dungeon Guide – Quests, Bosses, and Loot

author: Aaron Down
description:
Where the great city of Lordaeron once proudly stood, only desolate ruins remain. The good news is that this makes it the perfect location for some good ol’ fashioned plundering, and a cromulent quantity of Scourge-slaying. In World of Warcraft: Forever, the Ruins of Lordaeron serves as a low-level instance that sits just above the Undercity in Trisfal Glades. 

While this may intrinsically mark the Ruins of Lordaeron as a Horde-exclusive dungeon, there’s plenty of joy to be found if you take the plunge on your Alliance toon. As we’ll come to explain in the guide, getting to the instance isn’t nearly as daunting in Forever as it was in Classic. Of course, we’ll also give you the full Lordaeron lowdown, including all the quests you can cash in, bosses you can challenge, and, most importantly, all of the goodies you can potentially acquire for your efforts. For a comfortable time in R
title: WoW: Forever Ruins of Lordaeron Dungeon Guide – Quests, Bosses, and Loot

author: Aaron Down
description:
All we got to see of the gleaming city of Dalaran back in the day was a giant purple dome. This eventually changed with Wrath of the Lich King, but we never got to see its full splendor in Alterac Valley. In World of Warcraft: Forever, the magocratic municipality is fully open to visitors… provided they’re Alliance.

Nonetheless, the City of Daloran dungeon can be cleared by either faction, and it’s a doozy. Starting you off down in the sewers, you’ll make your way up onto its hallowed streets, clearing multiple bosses (and a fair share of trash) in the process. Here, we break down everything you’ll need to successfully navigate CoD, including how to get there, attunement steps, quests, major encounters, and more. We were clearing the instance comfortably at level 30 during the beta, so this stands as our recommended point of entry.
title: WoW: Forever City of Dalaran Dungeon Guide – Quests, Bosses, and Loot

description:

There are a ton of them out there, from major overhauls that completely shake up your UI, to roleplay-bolstering mods that track your journey across Azeroth. Quest helpers, bag managers, and even fishing enhancers, you can switch up almost any aspect of the game.
